items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: The interviewee only responds to the interviewer's story about Emil Bond with a comment about wine ('Blood? That was port wine?'), showing no personal connection or memory of Emil Bond himself.

ctx.x: You had too much blood for supper tonight.

Thank you. Do you know that that's what they used to call Poet Wine? One night I was down at the Apex Apartments and, uh, that the band had a rehearsal where they rehearsed numbers like The Saints and this was Emil Bond's band and they rehearsed, uh, Our Society. And I'll never forget Emil Bond's saying, hey man, give me some more of that blood, you know, and then eat down that wine and drink that wine. Oh yeah? And that's the first time I ever felt a whole building really shot, rock, you know. It was really, it…
something. Blood? That was port wine? I wonder if they call all red wine. They call all red wine?
